title: Special Project
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Pam returns to work shortly after giving birth, surprising her coworkers including Angela. Dwight is assigned to lead a special project in Tallahassee to develop Sabre stores and assembles a select team for the three-week business trip, causing tension among those not chosen. Andy and Dwight keep the selection criteria confidential, leading to frustration and debate among employees. Dwight conducts a tough orientation for the Florida team, revealing the project involves branching Sabre into retail with an Apple store-like concept. Meanwhile, personal relationships are highlighted, including Kelly and Ryan's sadness about their impending separation and Darryl's uncertainty about his relationship with Val. Jim prepares for his trip with Pam's support, while Kathy reveals concerns about Jim's marriage.
